name: Panorama Global
summary: US charity that sponsors global and domestic charitable projects across many causes, climate among them, inside Panorama or as grants to an established entity.

evidence.quote: We support global and domestic charitable projects that align with our mission of maximizing social impact across a broad range of social issues.
As your partner, we leverage our 501(c)(3) status and full breadth of resources, networks, and solutions.

projects.value: Charitable projects on a broad range of social issues; climate change is one it names

evidence.quote: We work with global changemakers addressing issues like public health, civic engagement, gender equality, climate change, and human rights

value.note: an established corporation with charitable programming, under its Model C

evidence.quote: Ideal for established entities, such as international charities, pre-existing domestic entities awaiting 501(c)(3) status, and corporations and 501(c)(4) organizations with charitable programming.
Panorama takes legal and fiduciary responsibility for charitable activities
accepting charitable donations on behalf of the project and regranting them to support activities

fees.value: Typically 10-12% under Model A, inside Panorama

evidence.quote: Typically, Model A projects are assessed at a 10-12% rate

fees.value: Typically 5-7% under Model C, as grants to you

evidence.quote: Typically, Model A projects are assessed at a 10-12% rate, while Model C projects are assessed at a 5-7% rate.

fees.value: Government and public funding case by case, with 15% of the total award

evidence.quote: Government and public funding opportunities are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, with an administrative cost of 15% of the total award

fees.value: A start-up or transfer cost may apply to existing initiatives

evidence.quote: we may apply a start-up or transfer cost for existing initiatives

min_income.value: Typically finalised once you have committed funding or a strong fundraising plan

evidence.quote: fiscal sponsorship is typically finalized once you have committed funding or a strong fundraising plan

value.note: Projects can receive donations and grants through it.

evidence.quote: Fiscally sponsored projects can receive donations and grants without waiting for their own 501(c)(3) status.

conditions.value: It helps review, approve and submit funding proposals, but doesn’t write them

evidence.quote: While we assist with reviewing, approving, and submitting funding proposals, the cost structure does not include the development of fundraising strategies, materials, or fundraising for fiscally sponsored projects.
Our functions include hiring staff internationally, contracting, and grantmaking in more than 20 countries.
Learn how Panorama can be the right fiscal sponsor for your project. Contact Us

steps.value: Due diligence and compliance review, then Panorama recommends a model

evidence.quote: Our process begins with a due diligence and compliance review to assess your project's mission, goals, activities, and the anticipated level of support. Based on this, we recommend one of our core fiscal sponsorship models
Can international initiatives seek fiscal sponsorship by Panorama? Yes! We have extensive experience supporting projects globally.
